name: comperdial
notes: 100 human-human persona-grounded dialogues (CPD challenge 2023, PersonaChat-style persona sentences for both speakers, A and B), plus human 'overall' scores for 10,395 responses from 97 dialogue systems on 15 of them -- the latter is what makes it useful for checking whether bleu/bertscore/persona_consistency track human judgment. The adapter exposes the generation task (next turn of speaker B); the human scores are kept on the conversation object (turn_judgments). Non-commercial license.
